newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-REVENGE FOR DUNDEE IN SCOTTISH LEAGUE CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REVENGE FOR DUNDEE IN SCOTTISH LEAGUE CUP.

text.p: Dundee avenged their defeat by Aberdeen in last season's Scottish League Cup final with a 2-1 quarter-final win over them on Tuesday.

Hosts Dundee went ahead through Paul Tosh in the first half but conceded a controversial 72nd minute penalty when a short back pass was intercepted by Billy Dodds and goalkeeper Billy Thomson was adjudged to have fouled him. Striker Dodds fired home the spot kick.

With Aberdeen down to 10 men after Dean Windass was sent off after being booked twice in two minutes, Dundee deservedly edged into the semifinals when Jim Hamilton broke the deadlock one minute from time.
Hearts striker John Robertson scored the only goal 20 minutes into extra time to send Celtic out.

Stefano Salvatori of Hearts was sent off in the 61st minute for a second booking but Celtic were unable to make progress and they lost Peter Grant for two cautions three minutes into the extra period.
Second-half goals from Dave Bingham and Gerry Britton earned Dunfermline a 2-0 victory over Partick and a place in the semifinals.
